blockers.detail: crc32_combine_gen(z_crc_t op[32], len) -> uLong crc32_combine_gen(len); crc32_combine_op(crc1,crc2,op) now takes uLong op

evidence: oss-fuzz issue 12299: build error due to change in interface for fast crc32

rationale.zh: 该提交把 crc32_combine_gen() 从“填充 32 项 z_crc_t 表”改为“返回单个 uLong 算子”，crc32_combine_op() 的第三个参数随之变为整数。OSS-Fuzz 托管的 checksum_fuzzer.c 仍按旧接口传入 z_crc_t op[32]，编译直接失败（too many arguments / incompatible pointer to integer）。属于本次引入的显式 api 退化，维护者在 oss-fuzz b41592118e 中修复。
rationale.en: This commit changes crc32_combine_gen() from filling a 32-entry z_crc_t table to returning a single uLong operator, and crc32_combine_op() now takes that integer. The OSS-Fuzz checksum_fuzzer.c still passes z_crc_t op[32], so it no longer compiles (too many arguments / incompatible pointer-to-integer). Explicit api degradation introduced by this change; fixed upstream in oss-fuzz b41592118e.
